decisions.reason: The materials management module extends the core practice software at modest ongoing cost and fits the firm's announced direction toward integrated, efficient practices, so there is no reason to write off the development invested in it after only a year.

The KIM secure messaging service is part of mandatory telematics infrastructure, was presented on a page of its own as a focus of the general update, and is central to the firm's publicly announced health-IT digitalization path, so dropping it is very unlikely.
